def main():
    n = int(input().strip())
    s = input().strip()
    
    longest_outside = 0
    inside_words = 0
    current_outside = 0
    inside_parentheses = False
    inside_word_exists = False
    
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        c = s[i]
        if c in ('(', ')', '_'):
            if c == '(':
                if current_outside > longest_outside:
                    longest_outside = current_outside
                current_outside = 0
                inside_parentheses = True
            elif c == ')':
                inside_parentheses = False
                if inside_word_exists:
                    inside_words += 1
                inside_word_exists = False
            else:  # '_'
                if current_outside > longest_outside:
                    longest_outside = current_outside
                current_outside = 0
                if inside_word_exists:
                    inside_words += 1
                inside_word_exists = False
            i += 1
        else:
            start = i
            while i < n and s[i] not in ('(', ')', '_'):
                i += 1
            length = i - start
            if inside_parentheses:
                inside_word_exists = True
            else:
                current_outside += length
    
    if current_outside > longest_outside:
        longest_outside = current_outside
    
    print(f"{longest_outside} {inside_words}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
